C1516.title: FBI Chicago PSA on 764, a Violent Online Group
C1516.summary: The FBI issued an alert about a violent online group known as 764, whose members coerce and manipulate minors online and induce extreme behaviors such as self-harm. Such activity can cause serious harm and psychological impact and reflects violent manipulation risks against minors in virtual spaces. The incidentTime should be verified against the FBI page publication date before being treated as exact.
